# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its wide package support and stability.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set a non-interactive frontend for package managers to prevent prompts during build.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# This single RUN command performs all necessary steps to build and install Kripke.
# It minimizes layer count, reducing the final image size.
RUN \
    # 1. Update package lists and install build-time and run-time dependencies.
    # - build-essential, cmake, git: Required for compiling the source code.
    # - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: Provide the MPI library for parallel execution.
    # - ca-certificates: Required for secure network connections (e.g., git clone).
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        build-essential \
        cmake \
        g++ \
        git \
        libopenmpi-dev \
        openmpi-bin \
        ca-certificates && \
    \
    # 2. Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
    # These settings prevent common issues with network interface detection and
    # CPU affinity when running inside cgroups-restricted containers.
    echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "btl = ^openib" >> /etc/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "hwloc_base_binding_policy = none" >> /etc/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "rmaps_base_mapping_policy = slot" >> /etc/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    \
    # 3. Clone the Kripke repository and its submodules from the default branch.
    # The repository's default branch is 'master'.
    # A shallow clone (--depth 1) is used to reduce download size.
    git clone --recursive --depth 1 --branch master https://github.com/LLNL/Kripke.git /opt/kripke && \
    \
    # 4. Configure and build Kripke.
    # - A separate build directory is created to keep source clean.
    # - -DENABLE_MPI=ON is crucial for enabling MPI support.
    # - make -j$(nproc) uses all available CPU cores to speed up compilation.
    cd /opt/kripke && \
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake -DENABLE_MPI=ON .. && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    \

    # - Remove the source code directory.
    # - Purge build-time dependencies that are not needed at runtime.
    # - Clean apt caches.
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/kripke && \
    apt-get purge -y --auto-remove build-essential cmake git libopenmpi-dev && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# This MiniCluster manifest deploys the Kripke HPC application using the Flux Operator.
# It is configured to run on a single node in an AWS CPU instance environment within Kubernetes.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster deployment.
  name: kripke-minicluster
  # The job will be deployed to the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's IndexedJob.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks for the flux run command.
  tasks: 1

  # Specify settings for the Flux Operator's logging.
  logging:
    # Enforce strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

  # Pods will not be deleted after the job completes.
  cleanup: false

  # Define the application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # The command to be executed by Flux. The Flux Operator will wrap this with 'flux run'.
      command: kripke
      # This container is a worker, not the job submitter.
      launcher: false

# This MiniCluster manifest deploys the Kripke HPC application using the Flux Operator.
# The previous run failed due to an invalid problem decomposition specified in the command arguments.
# This version corrects the issue by reverting to running kripke with no parameters, as instructed.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster deployment.
  name: kripke-minicluster
  # The job will be deployed to the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's IndexedJob.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks for the flux run command, targeting the c7a.12xlarge instance.
  tasks: 48
  # Pods will not be deleted after the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule the pod on a specific AWS AMD-based (x86) instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "c7a.12xlarge"
  # Define the application container.
  containers:
    - # The command is simplified to run kripke with no parameters to resolve the previous assertion failure.
      command: kripke
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # This container is a worker, not the job submitter.
      launcher: false
  # Specify settings for the Flux Operator's logging.
  logging:
    # Enforce strict schema validation for the CRD.
    strict: true

# This MiniCluster manifest deploys the Kripke HPC application using the Flux Operator.
# The previous attempt failed with an "Assertion Failed: Number of MPI ranks must match decomposition" error.
# This was because the application, when run with no arguments, defaults to expecting 1 process,
# but the MiniCluster was configured for 48 tasks.
# This manifest corrects the issue by explicitly telling Kripke to decompose the problem
# across the 48 tasks provided by Flux, using the --procs argument (4 * 4 * 3 = 48).
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster deployment.
  name: kripke-minicluster
  # The job will be deployed to the default namespace.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The total number of pods in the MiniCluster's IndexedJob.
  # Set to 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks for the flux run command.
  tasks: 48
  # Pods will not be deleted after the job completes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false
  # Pod-level specifications.
  pod:
    # Schedule the pod on a specific AWS AMD-based (x86) instance type.
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: "c7a.12xlarge"
  # Define the application container.
  containers:
    - # Corrected command to align the application's process grid with the spec.tasks count.
      command: kripke --procs 4,4,3 --niter 10 --zones 64,64,64 --groups 32 --dset 16
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:kripke
      # This container is a worker, not the job submitter.
      launcher: false
  # Specify settings for the Flux Operator's logging.
  logging:
